prompt.zh-TW: 風行腳踏車行上個月賒銷了一批通勤車給一家公司，這個月收到其中 {{money:e1.amount}}。這筆收款之後，下面四個數字各會怎麼變？
prompt.en: Last month Breeze Bicycles sold a batch of commuter bikes to a company on credit; this month it collects {{money:e1.amount}} of the amount owed. After this collection, how does each of the four figures below change?

explanation.zh-TW: 現金增加 {{money:e1.amount}}，{{term:tm_r7x2c9fa}}減少同樣的金額：一種資產換成另一種資產。收入和利益在上個月賒銷時就已經記了，所以這個月的營業收入與本期淨利都不動。收到錢，不等於又賺了一次。
explanation.en: Cash rises by {{money:e1.amount}} and {{term:tm_r7x2c9fa}} fall by the same amount: one asset turns into another. Revenue and profit were recorded last month at the time of the credit sale, so this month’s revenue and profit for the period do not move. Receiving the money is not earning it a second time.
